title: Cosmic Egg Reflection
description: A smug anthropomorphic yellow egg wearing a golden crown, red bow tie and black gloves stands at the water's edge. Behind it swirls a vibrant cosmic portal of purple, blue and green nebulae with a starry galaxy, all reflected perfectly in the dark rippling water below.
prompt: A smug anthropomorphic yellow egg character with half-lidded eyes, wearing a small golden crown, red bow tie and black gloves, standing beside a swirling cosmic portal filled with purple and blue nebulae, stars and galaxies against a swirling green cosmic background, the entire scene perfectly reflected in dark rippling water below, vibrant fantasy style with dramatic lighting
